title: CISA KEV: MONAI Label path traversal + N-able MailAssure SSRF (due Nov 26)
sum: Two actively-exploited flaws added to CISA KEV: an unauthenticated path traversal (leading to RCE) in medical-imaging AI server MONAI Label, and an SSRF in N-able MailAssure's LDAP sync check. Both due Nov 26.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch MONAI Label to 0.8.6; MailAssure Local Cloud to build 20261121.1943
M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — firewall the annotation server
M1030 Network Segmentation — isolate medical imaging servers

title: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) — active exploitation with public PoC
sum: Critical heap buffer overflow in Oracle OpenJDK (Java SE, GraalVM on x86-64 with AVX-512) with confirmed working PoCs; GreyNoise reports continued exploitation attempts. Requires the app to decode attacker-supplied Base64.
act: Oracle Java SE / OpenJDK / GraalVM workloads
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply Oracle/OpenJDK patches released Nov 17
M1040 Behavior Prevention on Endpoint — hunt post-exploit activity via EDR
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — confirm no exposed vulnerable runtimes

title: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) — chained RCE + priv-esc on exposed PAN-OS mgmt
sum: Critical PHP RCE chained with a kernel privilege-escalation for full root on exposed PAN-OS management interfaces (CVSS 9.2); Dream Research reports a campaign chaining both across 25+ servers.
ctl: M1037 Filter Network Traffic — block/resrict mgmt interface exposure
M1026 Privileged Account Management — protect management credentials
M1051 Update Software — apply PAN-OS hotfixes per advisory

title: Iran-linked maritime OT attacks on up to 50 commercial vessels via Fortinet
sum: US investigating suspected Iranian hacks of up to 50 oil/LNG/chemical ships; attackers exploited Fortinet FortiGate flaws to pivot from IT to OT (propulsion/navigation), with Coast Guard boarding vessels at US ports.
ctl: M1030 Network Segmentation — hard-separate IT from OT/vessel control
M0810 Network Allowlists — restrict maritime OT egress
M0801 Restrict Network Access — gate vendor/remote access to OT

title: CIA/ODNI unclassified intel-analysis system breached
sum: NYT/AP report a breach of a CIA open-source intelligence analysis system, with ODNI also affected. Compromised data was unclassified but sensitive; the issue is since resolved and the attacker unidentified.
ctl: M1026 Privileged Account Management — lock down reconnaissance-platform accounts
M1022 Restrict File & Directory Permissions — contain sensitive OSINT data
M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — monitor for follow-on intel-community attacks

title: Vanderbilt ransomware — BYOD group claims 1M+ SSNs stolen
sum: BYOD ransomware group forced all Vanderbilt devices offline (Nov 9) and claimed over 1M SSNs stolen; systems only partially restored and 11 federal class-action lawsuits filed by Nov 25.
ctl: M1053 Data Backup — verify offline recoverability after partial restoration
M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect PII/SSN stores at rest
M1047 Audit — scope exposure of the 1M+ SSN claim

title: Nitori data breach — 37.62M customer records exposed (Japan)
sum: Japanese furniture retailer disclosed potential exposure of 37.62M records (names, addresses, DOBs, membership details) from unauthorized access since mid-October; no passwords or card data compromised.
ctl: M1026 Privileged Account Management — review membership/member DB accounts
M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect member PII
M1022 Restrict File & Directory Permissions — limit bulk-member-data access

title: Microsoft Nov 2026 Patch Tuesday + OOB — Outlook NTLM leak KEV (CVE-2026-124194)
sum: Emergency out-of-band update fixed licensing/activation failures from the Nov patch itself, which covered 1,093+ CVEs including the exploited Outlook NTLM leak (CVE-2026-124194, KEV added Nov 10).
ctl: M1051 Update Software — bring all Windows systems to current build + OOB
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — blunt NTLM credential reuse
M1043 Credential Access Protection — monitor for leaked credential replay

title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect supply-chain compromise of MSPs — under investigation
sum: Compromise of MSPs via third-party extensions rather than a ScreenConnect vuln; ConnectWise disabled 5 extensions across ~400 partner environments, with Huntress reporting 47 orgs affected via 6 compromised MSPs.
ctl: M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — track SCKit/MSP-technician targeting
M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — vet third-party extensions
M1047 Audit — review remote-access session activity

title: Iran cold-chain attacks on French retailers attributed to IRGC Shahid Kaveh unit
sum: France formally attributed cold-chain defrost attacks (15 fires across retail sites) to Iran's IRGC Shahid Kaveh unit; separate CISA/FBI warning covers US cold-chain systems. Patch/replace end-of-life Danfoss controllers.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch or replace EOL Danfoss controllers
M1030 Network Segmentation — separate building/BMS from IT
M0801 Restrict Network Access — lock cold-chain control access
